row.weighting: Each of 4,350 natural rollout rows has equal weight.

scenario_equal.weighting: Each of 80 natural-rollout scenarios has equal weight after within-scenario averaging.

call.weighting: Each of the 360 confirmatory calls has equal weight.

state_side_mean.weighting: Each of 60 selected states has equal weight; K=3 calls are first averaged within side.
